decisions.decision: Hotel-level alerts (full shift), not just hotel-framed copy
decisions.rationale: User selected option A in scope confirmation; warranted full schema move + UI move

decisions.decision: Trailing 30 days, mature-only (>=90d), no dimension filters
decisions.rationale: Mirrors existing kiosk classifier window; >=90d MATURITY excludes ramp-up sites that score artificially low

decisions.decision: Tier-classify the composite score (0-100) directly using existing OutletTierConfig top/mid/bottom (default 80/50/20)
decisions.rationale: Composite score is already a weighted percentile in [0,100], so reusing classifyOutletTier is a clean fit. Avoids introducing a parallel cutoff config

decisions.decision: Per-row composite + 5 sub-metric percentiles + sticky weights footnote (not inline-formula-per-row, not minimal)
decisions.rationale: User selected option A in email-content question; balances signal density with readability

decisions.decision: Snapshot composite weights into app_settings ('composite_score_alert_weights_snapshot') as documentation row only — runtime still reads DEFAULT_SCORE_WEIGHTS in code
decisions.rationale: Audit-log readers can render the weights that were active at migration time; centralised tuning still happens in heat-map.ts

decisions.decision: Relax poc-batching.ts ClassifiedKiosk constraint to require only internalPocId (not kioskId)
decisions.rationale: Allows ClassifiedLocationRow to flow through groupByPoc without a parallel implementation. Field name `kiosks` retained for backwards-compat with existing test assertions
